name: Despondent
overview: Scripture addresses the state of being despondent by pointing believers to the hope and joy found in God through faith. Though despondency may arise, God promises blessing and restoration to those who draw near to Him, as He invites us to open our hearts to His presence. The God of hope fills believers with peace and joy by the power of the Holy Spirit, assuring us that through Christ's sacrifice, we have eternal life and a reason to abound in hope even in difficult times.
